determinism.note: covers frozen params, math audit, sweep, both world groups and the verdict; EXCLUDES cuda_time_ms, peak_vram_bytes, device and all clocks

block_operator.method: exact 2x2 block reduction (all blocks are polynomials in W)

math_audit.one_state_note: (1-delta)I + gamma*W has a purely real spectrum by construction; reproduces the design document's max|Im| = 0 finding.
math_audit.q_formula: Q = omega_d/(2*alpha); omega_d = |arg lambda| rad/wave; alpha = -ln|lambda| nepers/wave; dimensionless; per named mode

phase_convergence_sweep.note: DEV worlds only (0-5). Justifies the PHASE_SUBSTEPS freeze at a CONVERGED value rather than at the transient that flatters P4.
